genTemplate.templateContent:
MUTUAL RELEASE AND SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT

This Mutual Release and Settlement Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into as of {{effectiveDate}} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{partyA.name}}, {{partyA.entityType}} (“Party A”), and {{partyB.name}}, {{partyB.entityType}} (“Party B”). Party A and Party B are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.”

1. Background

A dispute has arisen between the Parties concerning {{disputeDescription}} (the “Dispute”). The Parties wish to resolve the Dispute fully and finally without further cost or proceedings, and without any admission of liability.

2. No Admission

This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims. Nothing in it is, or may be treated as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing or the validity of any claim or defence by either Party.

3. Settlement Payment

{{payingParty}} will pay {{settlementAmount}} within {{paymentDueDays}} days of the Effective Date by {{paymentMethod}}. Payment is the entire consideration for the releases in Section 4.

4. Mutual Release

On receipt of the settlement payment, each Party, on behalf of itself and its officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors and assigns, releases the other and its officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors and assigns from all claims, demands, liabilities, damages and causes of action, known or unknown, in contract, tort, statute or equity, arising out of or relating to the Dispute or to any matter occurring before the Effective Date.

5. Unknown Claims

Each Party understands that this release covers claims it does not currently know of or suspect, and that it may later discover facts different from or in addition to those it now believes to be true. Each Party accepts that risk and intends the release to remain fully effective regardless. Where California law applies, each Party expressly waives California Civil Code section 1542, which provides that a general release does not extend to claims the creditor does not know of or suspect to exist in its favour at the time of executing the release and that, if known, would have materially affected its settlement.

6. Carve-Outs

This release does not cover any obligation created by this Agreement, any claim that cannot lawfully be released, or any claim arising from conduct occurring after the Effective Date.

7. Dismissal of Proceedings

Within five business days of the settlement payment clearing, the Parties will take all steps necessary to dismiss any pending proceeding relating to the Dispute with prejudice, each bearing its own costs and fees.

8. Confidentiality

The Parties will keep the existence and terms of this Agreement confidential, except as required by law, regulation or court order, and except for disclosure to their professional advisers, insurers and auditors on a confidential basis. Either Party may state that the matter has been resolved.

9. Non-Disparagement

Neither Party will make any statement, public or private, that disparages the other or its products, services, officers or employees. Nothing in this section restricts truthful testimony or a report to a regulator.

10. Advice of Counsel

Each Party has had the opportunity to obtain independent legal advice on this Agreement, enters into it voluntarily, and is not relying on any representation not set out in it.

11. Authority

Each signatory represents that they are authorised to sign this Agreement on behalf of the Party for which they sign, and that the claims released have not been assigned to any third party.

Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

Entire Agreement

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both Parties. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
